spoken_summary: Donald Trump narrates the video, welcoming Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman of Saudi Arabia to the White House. He praises him as a partner for peace and prosperity, highlighting that their partnership is "stronger than ever before." Trump claims that Saudi Arabia will invest $1 trillion in the United States, up from a previous $600 billion. He also announces new agreements on nuclear energy and AI, a nearly $142 billion arms sale, and the formal designation of Saudi Arabia as a "major non-NATO ally." He concludes by thanking the Crown Prince and linking these achievements to his slogan, "Make America Great Again."
